name: R032-metronome-rage-miss
why: Rage only runs through Metronome. The player's Chansey (set 227) uses Metronome every turn (10 PP). The opponent's Azumarill (set 192) picks its moves at random at challenge 1: Protect (priority +3) or the first turn of Dig makes a Rage that Metronome calls miss, and BattleScript_RageMiss sets MOVE_EFFECT_RAGE before clearstatusfromeffect (battle_scripts_1.s:1129-1131). Chance per seed is about 10 calls x 1/340 x one in three that Azumarill is protected or underground.
